summary: Negros Occidental 1st District representative with 14 principal-authored bills. Authored contractor SALN disclosure for government infrastructure projects and an anti-dynasty ban. Co-authored a second anti-dynasty bill, the national minimum wage and an estate tax amnesty extension.
caveat: Small bill portfolio; economic items are co-authored and a single labor and tax mix, so economics is unscored.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
